SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '0' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , A.RULESORT_CD , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM RULECONDITION WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID) AS CONDITION_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM RULERETURNITEM WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID) AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , A.RULERETURN_TYPE , 0 AS RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , '' AS RETURN_DATATYPE , '' AS ITEM_NM , '' AS ITEMALIAS_NM , '' AS ITEM_ID , A.ALLRETURN_YN , 0 AS RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('9') AND A.RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT '1' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , B.RULECONDITIONNO , B.CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , ' ' || B.CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , '' AS RETURN_DATATYPE , '' AS ITEM_NM , '' AS ITEMALIAS_NM , '' AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , 0 AS RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULECONDITION B WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('9') AND A.RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y' AND A.RULEID = B.RULEID
UNION ALL
SELECT '2' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , B.RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , B.RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC AS RETURN_VALUE , C.DATATYPE_CD AS RETURN_DATATYPE , C.ITEM_NM , C.ITEMALIAS_NM , C.ITEMID AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , AA.RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULERETURNITEM AA , RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B , RULEITEM C WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('9') AND A.RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y' AND A.RULEID = AA.RULEID AND AA.RULEID = B.RULEID AND AA.RETURN_ITEMID = B.RETURN_ITEMID AND B.RETURN_ITEMID = C.ITEMID
UNION ALL
SELECT '3' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , 0 AS RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , C.DATATYPE_CD AS RETURN_DATATYPE , C.ITEM_NM , C.ITEMALIAS_NM , C.ITEMID AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , AA.RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULERETURNITEM AA , RULEITEM C WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('9') AND A.RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y' AND A.RULEID = AA.RULEID AND AA.RETURN_ITEMID = C.ITEMID ) T ORDER BY RULECONFIG_TYPE , RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , RETURNITEM_NO

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '0' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , A.RULESORT_CD , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM RULECONDITION WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID) AS CONDITION_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM RULERETURNITEM WHERE RULEID = A.RULEID) AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , A.RULERETURN_TYPE , 0 AS RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , '' AS RETURN_DATATYPE , '' AS ITEM_NM , '' AS ITEMALIAS_NM , '' AS ITEM_ID , A.ALLRETURN_YN , 0 AS RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '9')
UNION ALL
SELECT '1' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , B.RULECONDITIONNO , B.CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , ' ' || B.CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , '' AS RETURN_DATATYPE , '' AS ITEM_NM , '' AS ITEMALIAS_NM , '' AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , 0 AS RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULECONDITION B WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '9') AND A.RULEID = B.RULEID
UNION ALL
SELECT '2' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , B.RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , B.RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC AS RETURN_VALUE , C.DATATYPE_CD AS RETURN_DATATYPE , C.ITEM_NM , C.ITEMALIAS_NM , C.ITEMID AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , AA.RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULERETURNITEM AA , RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B , RULEITEM C WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '9') AND A.RULEID = AA.RULEID AND AA.RULEID = B.RULEID AND AA.RETURN_ITEMID = B.RETURN_ITEMID AND B.RETURN_ITEMID = C.ITEMID
UNION ALL
SELECT '3' AS RULECONFIG_TYPE , A.RULEID , A.RULE_NM , A.RULEALIAS_NM , '' AS RULESORT_CD , 0 AS CONDITION_COUNT , 0 AS RETURN_ITEM_COUNT , '' AS RULERETURN_TYPE , 0 AS RULECONDITIONNO , '' AS CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , '' AS CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , '' AS RETURN_VALUE , C.DATATYPE_CD AS RETURN_DATATYPE , C.ITEM_NM , C.ITEMALIAS_NM , C.ITEMID AS ITEM_ID , '' AS ALLRETURN_YN , AA.RETURNITEM_NO , A.USE_YN , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE A , RULERETURNITEM AA , RULEITEM C WHERE A.RULE_STATE IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '9') AND A.RULEID = AA.RULEID AND AA.RETURN_ITEMID = C.ITEMID ) T ORDER BY RULECONFIG_TYPE , RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , RETURNITEM_NO

SELECT B.RULEID , B.RULECONDITIONNO , B.POSTFIXOBJECTNO , B.OPERATOR_YN , B.DATATYPE_CD , B.OBJECT_DATA FROM RULE A , RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT B WHERE A.RULEID = B.RULEID ORDER BY B.RULEID ASC , B.RULECONDITIONNO ASC , B.POSTFIXOBJECTNO ASC

SELECT B.RULEID , B.RULECONDITIONNO , B.RETURN_ITEMID , B.POSTFIXOBJECTNO , B.OPERATOR_YN , B.DATATYPE_CD , B.OBJECT_DATA , AA.RETURNITEM_NO FROM RULE A , RULERETURNITEM AA , RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT B WHERE A.RULEID = AA.RULEID AND AA.RULEID = B.RULEID AND AA.RETURN_ITEMID = B.RETURN_ITEMID ORDER BY B.RULEID ASC , B.RULECONDITIONNO ASC , B.POSTFIXOBJECTNO ASC
SELECT ITEMID , ITEM_NM , ITEMALIAS_NM , DATATYPE_CD FROM RULEITEM WHERE ITEM_USE_YN = 'Y'
